name: inside_bar_breakout_5s
author: adapted from QuantGen_Subagent_3
thesis: An inside bar represents intraday equilibrium and volatility contraction. A breakout of the inside bar on increased volume indicates a resolution of this equilibrium. Exists because of localized order book vacuums after consolidation.
mechanism: Inside bars (narrowing range) indicate that buyers and sellers have reached temporary equilibrium. Orders accumulate on both sides of the narrowing range. The breakout from this compression triggers the accumulated orders, creating a directional thrust. The inside bar's range defines the energy that will be released in the breakout direction.
weaknesses: Extremely susceptible to algorithmic stop hunts (wicks)
Only effective during certain times of the day (e.g., first 2 hours)
Low win rate requires strict discipline on stops
adaptation_notes: Converted from 15min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 180x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; stop/target recalibration for 5-second timeframe. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
